raw_queries.sql:
-- Raw SQL Query on CSE-CIC-IDS2018 Friday 16/02/2018 capture:
SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC('minute', "Timestamp"::timestamp) AS flow_minute,
    "Src IP" AS source_ip,
    "Dst IP" AS dest_ip,
    "Dst Port" AS dest_port,
    "Label",
    COUNT(*) AS flow_count
FROM cse_cic_ids2018_raw_traffic
WHERE "Timestamp" >= '2018-02-16 10:00:00'
  AND "Timestamp" <= '2018-02-16 15:00:00'
  AND "Label" IN ('DoS-Hulk', 'DoS-SlowHTTPTest', 'Benign')
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3, 4, 5
ORDER BY flow_minute ASC, flow_count DESC;
raw_queries.python:
# Python / Pandas Query on CSE-CIC-IDS2018 raw CSV:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv("Friday-16-02-2018_TrafficForML_CICFlowMeter.csv")
df["Timestamp"] = pd.to_datetime(df["Timestamp"], format="%d/%m/%Y %H:%M:%S")
df["Minute"] = df["Timestamp"].dt.floor("min")

# Group by minute, source IP, and label
audit_table = (
    df.groupby(["Minute", "Src IP", "Dst IP", "Dst Port", "Label"])
    .size()
    .reset_index(name="FlowCount")
    .sort_values(by=["Minute", "FlowCount"], ascending=[True, False])
)

attacker_ip_change_explanation.error_origin: An earlier audit draft cited 18.219.211.138 as the attacker IP for DoS-Hulk. Cross-referencing the official UNB testbed schedule reveals that 18.219.211.138 was the designated external attacker node on Thursday, February 22, 2018 (Day 7) used exclusively for Web Attacks (Brute Force, XSS, and SQL Injection). It did not participate in the 16/02 attacks.

attacker_ip_change_explanation.quota_sampling_consequence: In src/data_collection/benchmark_pipeline.py, quotas took the first N=1,500 flows matching each label sequentially from cic.csv. Because cic.csv preserves sequential PCAP packet arrival order, all 1,500 candidate flows were captured from the onset of the single afternoon DoS-Hulk session (13:45 AST onward from source IP 172.31.70.16). The chronological 70/30 split assigned the initial high-rate burst phase (905 flows, median duration 146.6 ms) to training and the subsequent keep-alive/idle phase (389 flows, median duration 1358.6 ms) to testing. Uniform reservoir sampling in v1.3 resolves this by drawing flows uniformly across all sessions and chunks.
